title: POST /v1/push request
description: kind is the tracker's queue kind string, verbatim. fields per kind: Pending items batch {gates:[{gateKey,contractKey,gainsightAction}]}; Success Plan objective {event:'created'|'changed'|'verdict',objective,goalType,targetCycle,verdict,changeReason}; At-Risk CTA {ctaName,reason,severity}; Success Outcome Plan {outcomes:[string]}. Unknown keys inside fields are allowed.
